description.text: Mathematics and Applied Mathematics (Teacher Training) is a national first-class undergraduate major construction point, a key major in Zhejiang Province, a characteristic major in the "13th Five-Year Plan" of Zhejiang Province, and a provincial first-class undergraduate major construction point. This major won the 2018 and 2020 Most Employable Competitiveness Professional Comprehensive Award of Wenzhou University, and the 2020 Most Career Development Competitiveness Professional Comprehensive Award. To cultivate outstanding primary and secondary school teachers who master the basic theories and methods of mathematical sciences, have the ability to use mathematical knowledge and use computers to solve practical problems, have solid basic knowledge of mathematics and mathematics education, and have a high degree of specialization in teachers. Graduates can engage in teaching, research and research in education, science and technology, economics and other departments, or engage in practical application, development, research and management in production, operation and management departments. Main courses: mathematical analysis, advanced algebra, spatial analytic geometry, recent algebra, ordinary differential equations, probability theory and mathematical statistics, complex functions, real-variant functions, differential geometry, pedagogy, psychology, secondary mathematics teaching theory, elementary mathematics research, competition mathematics, modern educational technology applications, etc.

duration.text: The Mathematics and Applied Mathematics at Wenzhou University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Graduation certificate of high school.*Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.2.An official transcript from the school you have graduated.* Official transcript should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.3.Certificate of English proficiency test.*IELTS or TOEFL will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker(a minimum score should be obtained as follows: IELTS 6.0, TOEFL IBT 70, or TOEFL paper based 550).4.A photocopy of your passport.5.Bank statement (normally the balance is enough for your first year tuition fee and accommodation fee).6.No Criminal Report.7.Health report (within the period of validity).

requirements.text: 1.Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport;2.High school graduate or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate;3.Be in good health condition and above the age of 18.
